rows.quote: Logistic regression was used to estimate exome protein score association with cancer risk in UKBB and replication analyses were performed in the Multiethnic Cohort (MEC).
rows.coder_note: The authors' own replication analysis of exome protein scores in the Multiethnic Cohort (source and procedure stated); the dictionary has no Multiethnic Cohort row (rule C).

'79,148 overall prostate cancer cases from the PRACTICAL consortium': the Schumacher 2018 row has 79,194 cases, so the count is not its exact N, and no year, array or citation is given; a consortium name with a near count does not identify a release (rules D, I1; approximate N).

rows.quote: We additionally performed an inverse-variance weighted meta-analysis combining associations for these proteins estimated in EPIC with those in 21,481 men from UK Biobank (UKBB), of whom 1,147 developed prostate cancer.
rows.coder_note: The authors' own analysis of UK Biobank individual-level data, defined by an analytic sample (21,481 men, 1,147 incident prostate cancers) and a described procedure (protein associations; logistic regression of exome protein scores in the next sentence); no dictionary row is that analysis (rule C).
